features.quote: Add early-stopping: cap attempts at a fixed N (e.g., 8) — most spirals manifest by then and it bounds cost.

features.quote: Optimizing trigger rate per dollar pushes you toward the most adversarial, least realistic rigs — tasks rigged in ways that maximize despair output cheaply.
features.justification_quote: Your patches would learn to defeat your specific rigs, not to handle real repeated failure gracefully.
